quests.title: Witch's Chatter

dialogue.t: My oh my, the final product has exceeded all my expectations... If anyone actually does stumble in here by mistake, I'm sure they will be truly awe-inspired by this mage's might.

dialogue.sit: If someone really does end up here by accident...
Will you guide them to fulfill their wishes?

dialogue.t: Well, that all depends on the sort of person they are.
Guidance can encourage complacency and entitlement if you're not careful. If someone is eager to rely on their own abilities, like you do, then I'll gladly help them.
But if they're the type of person who pins all their hopes on the mage's power, while doing none of the work themselves... Hehe.
...W—Would you really turn them into a statue?
No, nothing like that. But I would guide them out of this place to the nearby Curatorium of Secrets. I'm sure Nefer would know how to deal with them much better than I do.
Those who seek to reap without sowing ought to pay the price, don't you think?

quests.description: After completing the mage’s lodge, the sounds of laughter and cheer can be heard coming from within…
